files.claim: The same discrete code sequence represents different time spans and modeled frequencies when the sampling rate changes.
files.inspection: Both themes inspected at full preview scale; exact rates, periods, spans, and modeled frequencies are legible with no clipping or collisions, and the comparison remains clear at thumbnail scale.

files.claim: Sampling, quantization, buffering, and calibration produce integer codes with distinct units and irreversible clipping limits.
files.inspection: The first pass exposed a clipped takeaway; the annotation was shortened and recentered. The second light/dark inspection found no clipping, collisions, illegible labels, or broken associations.
